{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Check for sentinel values
print("Number of -1 in customer_age:", (data['customer_age'] == -1).sum())

# Check revenue format
print("Unique revenue values (first 10):", data['revenue'].unique()[:10])

# Check for QA orders
qa_orders = data[data['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print("Number of QA orders:", len(qa_orders))

# Check for refunded orders
refunded = data[data['status'] == 'refunded']
print("Number of refunded orders:", len(refunded))

# Check channel and segment balance
print("Channel distribution:", data['channel'].value_counts())
print("Customer segment distribution:", data['customer_segment'].value_counts())"}
